title: Gemma 4 — Local Coordination Guide
hero_prompt: A wide 19th-century mechanical blueprint engraving: an open brass clockwork engine rests alone on a bare workbench, its gears meshing through paired hinge-and-latch mechanisms that lock together like couplings clicking shut, rendered in fine copperplate engraving lines.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast icon: two interlocking gear teeth rendered as one solid black engraved mark, thick strokes only, no fine hatching. A flat single-colour silhouette on a plain ground: no shading, no gradients, no glossy highlights, no fine lines; one bold shape that reads at 24 pixels.
